adj.description: Adjacency matrix: $1$ if $a$ is adjacent to $a'$, $0$ otherwise

r.description: Reward for a class $k$ flight being at location $a$ at time $t$

assumptions.description: Every location is adjacent to itself.

code.python: assert all(adj[a][a] == 1 for a in range(nA))
assert all(cap[a][t] >= 0 for a in range(nA) for t in range(nT))
assert all(nP[k] >= 0 for k in range(nK))

y.description: $1$ if flight $p$ of class $k$ is at location $a$ at time $t$, $0$ otherwise

z.description: $1$ if flight $p$ of class $k$ moves from $a$ at time $t$ to $a'$ at time $t+1$, $0$ otherwise

constraints.description: Each flight is at exactly one location at each time period.
constraints.formulation: \sum_{a \in A} y_{k,p,a,t} = 1 \quad \forall k \in K, p \in P_k, t \in T

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(gp.quicksum(y[k, p, a, t] for a in range(nA)) == 1 for k in range(nK) for p in range(nP[k]) for t in range(nT))

constraints.description: The flights of all classes at a location do not exceed the location capacity.
constraints.formulation: \sum_{k \in K} \sum_{p \in P_k} y_{k,p,a,t} \leq \text{cap}_{a,t} \quad \forall a \in A, t \in T

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(gp.quicksum(y[k, p, a, t] for k in range(nK) for p in range(nP[k])) <= cap[a][t] for a in range(nA) for t in range(nT))

constraints.description: Flow conservation: flights at location $a$ at time $t$ equal those at $t-1$ plus arrivals minus departures (one-step transitions).
constraints.formulation: y_{k,p,a,t} = y_{k,p,a,t-1} + \sum_{a' \in A} z_{k,p,a',a,t-1} - \sum_{a' \in A} z_{k,p,a,a',t-1} \quad \forall k \in K, p \in P_k, a \in A, t \in T, t > 0

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(y[k, p, a, t] == y[k, p, a, t-1] + gp.quicksum(z[k, p, a2, a, t-1] for a2 in range(nA)) - gp.quicksum(z[k, p, a, a2, t-1] for a2 in range(nA)) for k in range(nK) for p in range(nP[k]) for a in range(nA) for t in range(1, nT))

constraints.description: Movements are only allowed between adjacent locations.
constraints.formulation: z_{k,p,a,a',t} \leq \text{adj}_{a,a'} \quad \forall k \in K, p \in P_k, a, a' \in A, t \in T

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(z[k, p, a, a2, t] <= adj[a][a2] for k in range(nK) for p in range(nP[k]) for a in range(nA) for a2 in range(nA) for t in range(nT))

constraints.description: No movements out of the final time period (would arrive outside the horizon).
constraints.formulation: z_{k,p,a,a',nT-1} = 0 \quad \forall k \in K, p \in P_k, a, a' \in A

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(z[k, p, a, a2, nT-1] == 0 for k in range(nK) for p in range(nP[k]) for a in range(nA) for a2 in range(nA))

constraints.description: Movements at time $t$ require the flight to be present at time $t$ (depart only from where you are).
constraints.formulation: \sum_{a' \in A} z_{k,p,a,a',t} \leq y_{k,p,a,t} \quad \forall k \in K, p \in P_k, a \in A, t \in T

code.gurobipy: model.addConstrs(gp.quicksum(z[k, p, a, a2, t] for a2 in range(nA)) <= y[k, p, a, t] for k in range(nK) for p in range(nP[k]) for a in range(nA) for t in range(nT))

objective.description: Maximize total reward for all flights across all locations and time periods.
objective.formulation: \max \sum_{k \in K} \sum_{p \in P_k} \sum_{a \in A} \sum_{t \in T} r_{k,a,t} \times y_{k,p,a,t}

code.gurobipy: model.setObjective(gp.quicksum(r[k][a][t] * y[k, p, a, t] for k in range(nK) for p in range(nP[k]) for a in range(nA) for t in range(nT)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)

notes: This is the disaggregate (inefficient) formulation: one binary routing per individual flight.
